responsibility: This definition module declares the fixed-buffer Modula-2 interface for common filesystem queries and deletion. It belongs to the gm2 OS utility layer and exports `Exists`, `IsDir`, `IsFile`, `Unlink`, and `Access` on `ARRAY OF CHAR` pathnames, adapting the lower-level `CFileSysOp` access-mode model to callers that use ordinary Modula-2 character arrays rather than raw `ADDRESS` values or managed strings.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the FileSysOp pair: it declares filesystem operations on `ARRAY OF CHAR` pathnames, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/FileSysOp.mod` implements that interface by converting to `DynamicStrings.String` and delegating to `StringFileSysOp`.
